_comment: Golden query set for the MEMORY_SPEC section 11 deterministic gate.
retrieval: expect_ids is the relevant set for the query; the recall bar is measured at 10 and the
precision bar at 5 over this set. must_not is a hard veto independent of the bars: an id listed there
must not appear in the returned window at all. must_not is deliberately restricted to entries that are
retired, pending, or plainly off-topic, so a failure means retrieval leaked something it must not, not
that a curator's taste was not matched.
The FTS index covers the body column only, so query terms are drawn from fixture bodies. Two probes
with an empty expect_ids record that property on purpose: they assert the summary-only vocabulary does
NOT come back, which is what keeps a frontmatter word from answering a body query.
continuation: expect_threads are the threads the names-only hint must nominate for a keyword-less
continuation prompt to resolve without a model call.
gate: expect_ask is the warranted decision for the write described, at the shipped DefaultPolicy.
nudge: expect_nudge is whether the post-turn reminder should fire for the turn text.
